data.name: Fudayl
data.gender_notes: Fudayl is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fudayl is derived from the Arabic word 'fadaala' which means 'to help' or 'to save'. The name Fudayl carries the meaning “Help and Save” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fudayl usually hope their child will grow to embody help and save and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who helps and saves others.
data.etymology: Fudayl belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Help and Save.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fudayl total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فُضَيْل
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصل الفعل فضّل يفضّل أو يفضّلهُ، والفعل فاضل من الفعل فاضَلَ، وَهُوَ فَعَلَ مِن فَعَلَ، وَالفعل فَعَلَ مُشَكَّل من فَعِلَ، وَهُوَ فِعْلٌ مِن فِعِلَ، والفعل فِعِلَ مِن فَعِلَ، وَهُوَ فِعَلٌ مِن فِعَلَ، فَضَلَ يُفَضِلُ، وَالْفُضَالُ يُفَضِّلُ، وَالْفُضُولُ يُفَضِّلُ، وَالْفُضَيْلُ يُفَضِّلُ، وَالْفُضَالَةُ يُفَضِّلُ، وَفُضَيْلٌ مِنَ اللَهِ يُفَضِّلُ. وَكانوا يَقولون فُضَيْلُ الرَسولِ صَلّى اللَهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَكانَ أَبوهُ عَمروُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ قتَادةَ، وَكَذَلِكَ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ قتَادةَ، وَكَذَلِكَ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عَمروِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قتَادةَ. وَكانَ مِنَ الصَحَابةِ، وَكَذَلِكَ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عُبَيدةَ، وَكَذَلِكَ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ العَزيزِ. وَكَذَلِكَ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عَمروٍ

in_urdu.name: فضیل
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی راہ میں فضل اور برکت کا مستحق ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فضیل نام کا تعلق اس لفظ سے ہے جس کا معنی ہیں فضیلت والا، اور فضیلت ایسی برکت ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے نزدیک ہوتی ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال کئی صحابیوں کے ناموں پر ہوا ہے، جیسا کہ فضیل بن عُبیدہ، فضیل بن عمر بن عُبید اللہ، اور فضیل بن عمرو۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ुदयल
in_hindi.meaning: वह व्यक्ति जो अल्लाह की राह में कृपा और अनुग्रह का योग्य होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ुदयल नाम का संबंध उस शब्द से है जिसका अर्थ है कृपा और अनुग्रह। यह अल्लाह के सामने मूल्य वाला होता है। इस नाम का उपयोग कई सहाबियों के नामों पर किया गया था, जैसे फ़ुदयल बिन इब्न अदीह, फ़ुदयल बिन उमर बिन इब्न अदीह, और फ़ुदयल बिन अम्रो।

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic history, Fudayl ibn Iyad was a well-known scholar, mystic, and Sufi spiritual master. He was born in 893 AD in Iraq and is considered one of the earliest pioneers of the Sufi path in the Islamic world. Fudayl's teachings and inspirations have had a significant impact on the development of Sufism and the Islamic world as a whole. His unique approach to Sufism, emphasizing the importance of self-mastery, seeking God's love, and the realization of the presence of God, has influenced generations of Sufi scholars and seekers.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fudayl holds spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition as it comes from the Arabic word 'fadaala,' meaning 'to help' or 'to save.' Muslims believe that God is ever-helpful and always ready to save them from their troubles and hardships. The name is a reminder of God's mercy and compassion, and Muslims may seek his blessings and protection by using this name in their daily prayers and rituals. Fudayl also embodies the idea of self-help and personal responsibility in one's spiritual journey, emphasizing the importance of personal effort and discipline in seeking God's presence and love.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Fudayl signifies 'sold of Allah'. It is a reminder of the believer's eternal bond and commitment to Allah, symbolizing absolute devotion and submission.
